$comment: LS-5201 sewage lift station twin (wet well + 2 x Flygt NP 3153 duty/standby + rising main). Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the pump data, the station drawings and the operating philosophy; the PLC sends only what it measures.

identification.model: 2 x Flygt NP 3153.181 submersible N-pump, duty/standby
identification.description: Municipal sewage lift station: wet well, two submersible pumps duty/standby, check valves, rising main
identification.pumps: Flygt NP 3153.181: submersible wastewater pump with self-cleaning N-impeller, installation P (guide bars, automatic discharge connection), 13.5 kW 4-pole 50 Hz
identification.valves: One swing check valve and one isolation valve per pump, in a dry valve chamber next to the wet well
identification.main: DN 250 ductile iron rising main, 1.8 km, to a receiving manhole on higher ground
identification.control: Station PLC with radar level transmitter and a backup high-level float; telemetry to the regional SCADA

pump.source: maker: Flygt 3153 50 Hz technical specification (N-pump, 4-pole 13.5 kW line of the motor table) and the Flygt N-technology brochure. Duty point 55 l/s at 13 m, shut-off head, hydraulic efficiency at the duty point (taken as the best efficiency point), motor efficiency, pump inlet diameter and its height above the wet-well floor: assumption: typical value, replace with your pump curve for your impeller number (Xylem selection software) and the station drawing

well.source: Levels are metres above the wet-well floor. Round wet well, pump stop, duty start, standby (assist) start, high level alarm (and backup float), invert of the incoming sewer and the emergency overflow weir: assumption: typical value, replace with your station drawings and control philosophy

main.source: Rising main inner diameter and length, outlet (receiving manhole) and pressure gauge heights above the wet-well floor, pressure wave speed in the full ductile iron main, sewage density taken as water: assumption: typical value, replace with your rising main drawings and surge study

inflow.source: Dry-weather inflow (mean and daily swing) and a design storm inflow: assumption: typical value, replace with your catchment model or flow survey

demo.note: Demo only: the plant clock runs 60 times faster, so one day of inflow takes 24 minutes and a pump cycle a few seconds of real time.

groups.Cycle: Last pump cycle (drawdown test by the PLC)

points.label: Rate of level change over the last minute (PLC)
P1 leakage sensor FLS 10 (1 = water in the inspection chamber)
P2 leakage sensor FLS 10 (1 = water in the inspection chamber)
Rising main pressure in the valve chamber
Pump of the last cycle (1 or 2)
Level rise rate in the minute before the start
Level rise rate in the minute after the stop
Peak pressure in the valve chamber at the stop (fast logger)

limits.source: Alarm levels: assumption: typical value, replace with your operating philosophy. starts_alert_h is half the 30 starts per hour of the Flygt specification; velocity_min_ms is a commonly used self-cleansing velocity for rising mains; submergence margin 1.0 = the ANSI/HI 9.8 minimum.

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

impeller_ragging.name: Ragging: wipes and rags wrapped on the impeller
impeller_ragging.symptoms: less flow and more power at the same head (drawdown test)

impeller_wear.name: Impeller and insert ring wear (gap grows)
impeller_wear.symptoms: less flow at the same head, power at that head not higher

main_restriction.name: Rising main partly blocked or air-locked
main_restriction.symptoms: higher head, lower flow along the pump curve; main resistance up

check_valve_passing.name: Check valve passing (does not close tight)
check_valve_passing.symptoms: the main drains back after each stop: the well rises faster after the stop than before the start

check_valve_slam.name: Check valve slam (closes late, after reverse flow)
check_valve_slam.symptoms: pressure spike at every stop; reverse velocity from Joukowsky above the limit

storm_inflow.name: Storm or infiltration inflow above the station capacity
storm_inflow.symptoms: both pumps running and the well still rising; time to spill counts down

level_sensor_fault.name: Level transmitter fouled (fat, foam): reads low
level_sensor_fault.symptoms: backup float trips while the radar shows a normal level

seal_leak.name: Mechanical seal leak on P2
seal_leak.symptoms: leakage sensor FLS 10 of P2 trips
